summary: This memo lists, as best known at the time, common Internet country domains and how they correspond to telex answerback codes, along with telex and international dialing codes where available. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Before the Internet was everywhere, many businesses used telex machines with short codes for each country. This paper is a lookup table matching those codes to Internet country endings.
